semantics.state: Eight D flip-flop outputs Q[0] through Q[7], with no reset port or initialization specified.
semantics.transition: On each positive clock edge, if enable is high, Q[0] receives S and each Q[i] for i=1..7 receives the prior Q[i-1]. Otherwise all bits hold.
semantics.read: Combinational Z = Q[index], where index is ABC with A most significant and C least significant; no read latency.
semantics.evidence: Original states S feeds Q[0], synchronous active-high enable, all sequential logic positive-edge triggered, and ABC=000 selects Q[0], ABC=001 selects Q[1], and so on.
semantics.structure: Only an eight-bit shift register and multiplexers.

numeric.bit_order: Serial MSB first yields first bit in Q[7] after eight enabled edges.

verification.oracle: Independent per-bit historical state model based on original text
cases: Partial fill and propagation of unknown bits
No change on negative edges or S changes
verification.sampling: Check after settling following positive edges and asynchronous address changes
verification.termination: Fatal on mismatch, bounded timeout, PASS only on completion

specification_ambiguities: No reset or power-up values are specified; RTL leaves flip-flops uninitialized and simulation tests expect unknown bits until written. Inputs with unknown enable or address are not assigned additional behavioral requirements.
